questions.q_en: Two cars race around a circular track at a constant speed starting from the same point. If they travel in the opposite directions, they meet in every 35 seconds. If they travel in the same direction, they meet in every 3 minutes and 30 seconds. How long would the faster car take to complete one round of the circular track?
questions.solution_en:
When the cars travel in opposite directions, they meet in 35 seconds for the first time

So, let us suppose that the fraction of the circle travelled by slower car be f and the fraction of circle travelled by the faster car be k

So, that f+k=1... (1)

Now when they travel in same direction, they meet in 210 seconds

210 = 6 times 35

So now we see that in 210 seconds the faster car overtakes the slower car by one complete circumference of the circle

That means in 35 seconds, the faster car has covered 1/6 more distance than the distance covered by the slower car

=> f-k = 1/6 ... (2)

=> Solving (1) and (2) we get 2f = 7/6

=> f = 7/12

Hence, distance covered by the faster car in 35 seconds is 7/12th of the circle

Solving by unitary method, we get that time taken by the faster car to complete one round = 60 seconds

questions.q_en: Ramesh and Suresh starts in the same direction from the same point around a circular track. They both start at the same time and Ramesh who runs faster than Suresh catches him 425 meters away from the starting point. If the ratio of their speeds is 2 : 7 then what is the total length of the track?
questions.solution_en:
Let the diameter of the track be d' meter hence total length of the track will be '2d' meters.

When first time Ramesh catches Suresh then total distance travelled by Suresh = 425 m

Since both are running from the same point in the same direction hence Ramesh will catch Suresh for the 1st time when he has travelled one complete round more than Suresh.

Hence total distance travelled by Ramesh when they met for the 1st time = (2d + 425) m

According to the question we will get; 425/(2d+425)=2/7

=> 7 X 425 = 2(2d + 425)

=>2975 = 4d + 850

=> 2d = 1062.5

Hence total length of the track is 1062.5 m.

questions.q_en: A and B are running on a circular track of 1700 m. Speed of A is 33 m/s and speed of B is 23 m/s. They start from the same point at the same time in the same direction. After how much time will they meet again for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 33 - 23 = 10 m/s

Distance = 1700 m

Required time = 1700/10 = 170 sec
questions.solution_hi:
Relative speed = 33 - 23 = 10 m/s

Distance = 1700 m

Required time = 1700/10 = 170 sec

questions.q_en: In a circular race of 3000 m, A and B start from the same point and at the same time, at speeds of 24 km/h and 39 km/h, respectively. After what time will they meet for the first time on the track if they are running in the same direction?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 39 - 24 = 15 km/h = 15 x 5/18 = 75/18 m/sec

Distance = 3000 m

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 3000/ (75/18) = 720 sec

questions.q_en: In a circular race of X m, P and Q start from the same point and at the same time, at speeds of 40 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. If they are running in the same direction and meet for the first time on the track after 36 seconds, then find the value of X.
questions.solution_en:
Relative Speed = 40 - 30 = 10 km/h = 10 x 5/18 = 50/18 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time on the track = 36 seconds

Therefore,

X = (50/18) x 36

X = 100 m

questions.q_en: Nishu walks around a circular field at the speed of 3 rounds per hour, while Aman runs around it at the speed of 11 rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 7: 15 p.m. Find the time at which they cross each other.
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 11 - 3 = 8 rounds per hour

Time = Distance of 1 round/relative speed = 1/8 hours = 60/8 = 7.5 minutes

They start at 7: 15 P.M, so they will cross each other at: 7: 15 + 7.5 minutes = 7: 22: 30 seconds (PM)

questions.q_en: Two people, M and N, are running in the same direction at the speeds of 3X km/h and X km/h respectively, on a circular track of 40 km. Find the speed of M, if they meet again after 5 hours.
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 3X - X = 2X km/h

Distance = 40 km

Time = 40/2X

5 = 20/X

X = 4

Speed of M = 3X = 12 km/h

questions.q_en: P and Q start running simultaneously, around a circular track of 1600 m, in the same direction, at a speed of 10 m/s and 16 m/s, respectively. P and Q will meet at the starting point for the first time after:
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by P to complete 1600 m = 1600/10 = 160 sec

Time taken by Q to complete 1600 m = 1600/16 = 100 sec

Time taken by P and Q to meet at the starting point for the first time = LCM of 160 and 100 = 800 seconds

questions.q_en: On a 450 m long circular track, two people start from the same point, at the same time, at speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively. After how much time will they meet at the starting point for the first time after:
questions.solution_en:
36 km/h = 36 x 5/18 = 10 m/s

Time taken by them to complete 450 m alone = 450/10 = 45 sec and 450/15 = 30 sec.

Time taken by them to meet at the starting point for the first time after = LCM of 45 and 30 = 90 sec

questions.q_en: In a circular race of 1240 m, A and B start from the same point, at the same time and at speeds of 34 km/h and 66 km/h, respectively. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction? (correct to the nearest whole number)

questions.q_en: Abhi and Nikki walk along a circular track in opposite directions. Abhi completes 3 rounds in 1 minute and Nikki completes 4 rounds of the track at the same time. They start from the same point and walk for 2 minutes. How many times will they meet on the track between start time and end time?
questions.solution_en:
They are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed = 3 + 4 = 7 rounds per minute

In 1 minute, they complete 7 rounds together, meaning they meet 7 times per minute.

In 2 minutes, the total number of meetings will be: 7 x 2 = 14 times

questions.q_en: A, B, and C run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 900 m, at respective speeds of 13 m/s, 17 m/s, and 21 m/s in the same direction. After how much time will they meet for the first time?

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 900/4 = 225 sec = 3 minutes 45 seconds

questions.q_en: P and Q participate in a circular race of 1.7 km. They start the race at a speed of 21 km/hr and 38 km/hr respectively, from the same point at the same time. After how much time (in minutes) will they meet at the starting point for the first time, if they are running in the same direction?
questions.solution_en:
Distance to be covered = 1.7 km = 1700 m

Relative speed = 38 - 21 = 17 km/hr = 17 * 5/18 m/sec = 85/18 m/sec

Required time = 1700 * (18/85) sec

= 360 sec

= 6 min
